profile.positioning: I’m a passionate learning strategist and design leader dedicated to unlocking human potential through innovative and impactful learning experiences. Currently, I’m focused on building the learning and development function from the ground up at NovaSkills, a Series A EdTech startup revolutionizing professional development through personalized microlearning. We’re tackling the challenge of skills gaps in a rapidly evolving job market by delivering highly relevant, bite-sized content tailored to individual needs. Previously, I led the Learning & Development team at CloudStream Solutions, where I spearheaded the implementation of ‘LearnFlow,’ our proprietary AI-powered learning platform. This initiative resulted in a 35% reduction in onboarding time and a 20% increase in employee skill proficiency within the first year. I thrive in fast-paced environments and am adept at aligning learning strategies with business objectives, fostering a culture of continuous learning, and leveraging data to drive measurable results.
